title: Robust Experimental Design via Generalised Bayesian Inference
abstract: arXiv:2511.07671v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Bayesian optimal experimental design is a principled framework for conducting experiments that leverages Bayesian inference to quantify how much information one can expect to gain from selecting a certain design. However, accurate Bayesian inference relies on the assumption that one's statistical model of the data-generating process is correctly specified. If this assumption is violated, Bayesian methods can lead to poor inference and estimates of information gain. Generalised Bayesian (or Gibbs) inference is a more robust probabilistic inference framework that replaces the likelihood in the Bayesian update by a suitable loss function. In this work, we present Generalised Bayesian Optimal Experimental Design (GBOED), an extension of generalised Bayesian inference to the experimental design setting which achieves robustness in both design and inference. translated_title: 基于广义贝叶斯推断的鲁棒实验设计
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯最优实验设计是一个开展实验的原则性框架，它利用贝叶斯推断来量化选择某个设计所能期望获得的信息量。然而，准确的贝叶斯推断依赖于一个假设，即对数据生成过程所建立的统计模型是正确设定的。如果该假设不成立，贝叶斯方法可能导致糟糕的推断以及不准确的信息增益估计。广义贝叶斯（或称Gibbs）推断是一种更鲁棒的概率推断框架，它用合适的损失函数替代贝叶斯更新中的似然函数。在本工作中，我们提出了广义贝叶斯最优实验设计（GBOED），将广义贝叶斯推断扩展到实验设计场景中，从而在设计与推断两方面均实现鲁棒性。利用贝叶斯决策理论的一个推广形式，我们推导了一种新的采集（函数）……
tldr: 本文提出广义贝叶斯最优实验设计（GBOED），通过用损失函数替代似然函数，在模型设定存在偏差时同时保证实验设计与统计推断的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Generalised Bayesian Optimal Experimental Design (GBOED), which replaces the likelihood with a suitable loss function to achieve robustness in both experimental design and inference under model misspecification.
